name: Akfa Group (AKFA Holding)
note: Uzbek industrial holding (plastic and aluminium profiles, windows, heating systems, construction materials). Founder identified by Gazeta.uz and Spot as Jahongir Artykkhodjaev (hokim of Tashkent 2018-2023), who per the club is also Pakhtakor's chairman and per Podrobno.uz (Aug 2026, unconfirmed) reportedly ended his financing of the club.
